neighbours.label: ' at' linking a research actor to an institution: 'Researchers / Scientists / Investigators at <university or institute>'. Other uses of ' at' (time, place, students or workers at ...) stay quiet.

notes: Card: ' at' x15 of the top 32, nearly all 'Researchers at'; also 'Dr', ' Scott', ' RESULTS' in science reporting. Probe: Researchers/Scientists at 0.65, Investigators at 0.43, Doctors/Engineers at 0.24, Students at 0.05, Workers at 0.02; 'researchers from' 0.33 and 'Researchers in' 0.25, so other affiliation prepositions fire weakly too.
